articles.title: Backstage Magic: Photographers Share Their Favorite Tiny Desk Tour Moments
articles.summary: Imagine a concert where the band warms up on the stairs and the crowd’s joy lights up the room. Photographers on the Tiny Desk Contest tour captured these real, unfiltered moments in 10 cities. See the tour through their eyes.

articles.title: A Golden Ticket to Space: Swatch’s New MoonSwatch Has a Secret Price Trick
articles.summary: Swatch is selling a new gold MoonSwatch for about $620 — the price of gold in 1969! Only 1,969 lucky people can buy it, but first they must answer 32 tricky questions. It’s like a space-age lottery to avoid the chaos of past launches.

articles.title: The Actor Who Plays Eumaeus in The Odyssey Is Everywhere — Here’s Why You Know Him
articles.summary: You’ve seen John Leguizamo in tons of movies, from the Ice Age sloth Sid to Encanto’s Bruno. Now he’s playing a blind swineherd in Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey. He says filming was intense but Nolan was right there with him in the freezing cold.
